summary: Practise Power Query, Excel analysis, DAX and Power BI reporting. Review course outcomes and enrol in the training.
lede: Data analytics with Excel and Power BI helps analysts, finance professionals and reporting teams turn business data into checked analysis and usable reports. You practise checking source quality, preparing tables with Power Query, defining KPIs, analysing trends and variances in Excel, validating DAX measures against source totals, and presenting findings in Power BI reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, validate or explain spreadsheet-based analysis and Power BI reports as part of their regular work.
modules: Excel Data Questions and KPI Definitions
Power BI Visuals and Report Review
Power BI Findings and Management Reporting
prerequisites: Working familiarity with Excel tables, basic formulas and charts. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel and Power BI Desktop installed; use your existing software access.
